note: Made by tools/proof.cjs with made-up people and code-drawn placeholder photos.

examples.title: Grandma June's Christmas News
lyrics: Biscuit ate the gingerbread house, roof and all,
Theo lost his first tooth, left a gap so small,
Ada's bike lost its training wheels, off she flew,
Grandma June, we saved up all this news for you.
Merry Christmas, Grandma June, we love you so,
And we miss your cinnamon rolls, you know,
From the Timmermans with love and mistletoe,
Merry Christmas, Grandma June, we love you so.

examples.title: Undefeated Uncle Dave
lyrics: Uncle Dave, your reindeer's back,
Same old sweater since ninety-eight,
Every turkey charcoal black,
You call it 'caramelised' on the plate!
Shout it loud for Uncle Dave,
Undefeated at charades!
Sweater's tired, the turkey's charred,
But you're the best uncle by far!

examples.title: Nora Turns Thirty
lyrics: Up at six and running through the rain,
Clint the starter rising once again,
You said you hate surprises, and it's true,
But this one's the exception, made for you!
Nora! Nora! Thirty and you shine,
Lucky me, I get to call you mine,
Nora! Nora! Light the candles bright,
Thirty years and you're the party's light!
